title: PathRollbackPlan.v1
description: The plan to undo a path promotion by moving the active-path pointer for a capability_slot back to the prior baseline — and ONLY the pointer. rollback_target_path_id is the path the pointer reverts to (the prior baseline, == the promotion's rollback_target); from_path_id is the currently-promoted candidate the pointer moves AWAY from but is NEVER deleted (deletes_paths MUST be false, deletes_prior_runs MUST be false). A path promotion is always reversible because every PathPromotionDecision carries a rollback_target; this plan executes that reversal. References the promotion_decision_id it reverses. Mirrors the lossless distillation RollbackPlan: promotion is a pointer move, rollback is the inverse pointer move, the losing/winning paths and prior ParallelPathRuns are all KEPT.

capability_slot.description: the capability whose active-path pointer will move

from_path_id.description: the promoted candidate the pointer moves AWAY from; kept, never deleted

rollback_target_path_id.description: the prior baseline the pointer reverts to (== the promotion's rollback_target)

deletes_paths.description: MUST be false — rollback moves the pointer only, never deletes a path definition

deletes_prior_runs.description: MUST be false — prior ParallelPathRuns stay readable after rollback

reason.description: why rollback (e.g. handle-coverage dropped, held-out leak detected post-promotion, cost regression)

rollback_receipt_id.description: the receipt written when the plan executes
